comment: The agreed build configuration list for analysis scope. Scope is per configuration, not per
repository: a target is not a configuration, so a count or a coverage claim that does not name
The list is enumerated rather than taken as the cross product of board, port, platform_baremetal
and EXCLUDE_APP. Configurations deliberately left out are recorded below with the reason, so an
omission is visible rather than assumed.

frozen_output names the build's own generated frozen_content.c for a configuration. The resolver compares its resolved module set against what the build actually embedded, which is the only independent oracle available short of reimplementing the manifest DSL. libs-only has none: it is a variant of the firmware build and does not produce its own.

artefact_dir is where the configuration's compile-commands target writes its compile_commands.json and includes.json: the sast/ subdirectory of its own build directory, beside the firmware. A configuration with none produces no database of its own.

configurations.name: stm32-USB2CAN_NUCLEO_H563ZI-libs-only
configurations.reason: EXCLUDE_APP=1 drops src/firmware entirely, so it is the configuration that shows which frozen modules are application rather than library. It has no compilation database of its own because its set of translation units matches the firmware build's. Note that the contents differ: EXCLUDE_APP changes the frozen manifest, so the generated frozen_content.c is a different translation unit by content, which an analyser reads.

configurations.name: mimxrt-USB2CAN_SEEED_ARCH_MIX
configurations.reason: The second board, on a different port. Its first-party header is included by no other configuration, so omitting it would leave that header unanalysed.

configurations.name: unix-standard
configurations.reason: platform_baremetal is false here, so it is the only configuration that freezes the test modules and the simulation package. It is also the execution vehicle for the CVE detection benchmark.

excluded.name: stm32-USB2CAN_NUCLEO_H563ZI-mboot
excluded.reason: The bootloader has its own compilation database because it compiles this repository's first-party C, but it freezes no Python and includes no manifest, so it has no manifest scope to resolve.

excluded.name: mpy-cross
excluded.reason: The host-built bytecode compiler is analysed as its own configuration, with its own compilation database (make compile-commands-mpy-cross), because it builds py/ with every native emitter enabled, which no firmware configuration does. Like the bootloader it freezes no Python and includes no manifest, so it has no manifest scope to resolve.

excluded.name: mimxrt-USB2CAN_SEEED_ARCH_MIX-libs-only
excluded.reason: EXCLUDE_APP interacts with the manifest chain identically on both boards, the board manifests differing only in the mimxrt board's extra freeze of the port's own modules. Resolving it on one board demonstrates the mechanism; the cross product of board and EXCLUDE_APP is not worth exhausting.

excluded.name: unix-openmv
excluded.reason: ENABLE_OPENMV selects a different unix variant in the Makefile, but this repository has no src/system/UNIX_OPENMV directory, so the variant does not exist here. It exists in skydeck and is in scope when the technique is applied there.
